title: Step Ladder Lightweight Compact Safety Certified 2 3 4 Steps
description:
Step Ladder Lightweight Compact Safety Certified 2 3 4 Steps
Free Delivery to Residential Areas only
CBD Commercial Area $10 delivery fee. No delivery to restricted areas, Jurong Island and Airport.

2 / 3 /4 Steps Ladder GS TUV Certified EN14183. Step Ladder offers Maximum Stability and Security.
Genuine product. You will receive the exact product as marketed.
Ideal for usage in the office and at home.

Max load: 150kg.
Refer to images for product dimensions and measurements.

Modern, Light weight, Slim and Compact to fit in tight spaces for storage. No sharp edges (all rounded) for child safety.
Aluminium step Ladder/stool comes with an anti slip surface on every step, and has a U-shaped handle at the top for extra grip and security. Ladder is reinforced with top quality materials for safety, stability and to withstand the test of time.
Each step is broad and wide, ensuring your safety while providing comfort. Foldable to fit in tight spaces for storage.
source_text:
Step Ladder Lightweight Compact Safety Certified 2 3 4 Steps Step Ladder Lightweight Compact Safety Certified 2 3 4 Steps
Free Delivery to Residential Areas only
CBD Commercial Area $10 delivery fee. No delivery to restricted areas, Jurong Island and Airport.

2 / 3 /4 Steps Ladder GS TUV Certified EN14183. Step Ladder offers Maximum Stability and Security.
Genuine product. You will receive the exact product as marketed.
Ideal for usage in the office and at home.

Max load: 150kg.
Refer to images for product dimensions and measurements.

Modern, Light weight, Slim and Compact to fit in tight spaces for storage. No sharp edges (all rounded) for child safety.
Aluminium step Ladder/stool comes with an anti slip surface on every step, and has a U-shaped handle at the top for extra grip and security. Ladder is reinforced with top quality materials for safety, stability and to withstand the test of time.
Each step is broad and wide, ensuring your safety while providing comfort. Foldable to fit in tight spaces for storage.
